description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Table, which handles validation and processing of HTML table child elements within the HTMLPurifier library. It manages table structure validation, including handling of elements like tr, tbody, thead, tfoot, caption, colgroup, and col.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Table
classes.description: Class responsible for defining and validating the structure of HTML table child elements according to different specifications and handling complex table structures.

methods.name: validateChildren
methods.description: Validates and processes the child nodes of a table element, ensuring correct structure, handling modes for thead/tbody/tfoot, and wrapping stray tr elements in tbody when necessary.
